1. Certification Consultancy

Standards Covered: ISO 27001 (ISMS), ISO 9001 (QMS), ISO 14001, ISO 45001, IATF 16949, CMMI Development Services, TISAX, ISO 27701, ISO 22301, HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2, and PCI DSS.

Core Services Offered

Gap Analysis & Process Definition

Evaluating existing processes, providing rigorous process definition, and implementing QMS/ISMS operational controls.

Documentation Design

Drafting customized quality manuals, SOPs, ISMS documentation, policies, and work instructions tailored to workflows.

Internal Audits & Reviews

Performing mock audits and independent quality reviews to correct non-conformities beforehand.

Awareness & Internal Auditor Training

Conducting ISO 27001 awareness, internal auditor modules, and workshops for CMMI, TISAX, and PCI DSS.

Certification Body Co-ordination

Full liaison and scheduling support with TÜV, SGS, Bureau Veritas, NABCB, and other accredited registrars.

Step-by-Step Implementation Lifecycle

Step 01: Initial Consultation & Scoping

Defining project scope, choosing the appropriate standard, and setting timelines.

Step 02: Process Mapping & Definition

Aligning internal company workflows with standard clauses and defining implementation metrics.

Step 03: Implementation & Rollout

Deploying new workflows, operational controls, and documenting evidentiary artifacts.

Step 04: Final Certification Audit

Managing external auditor interactions until the certificate is successfully issued.

2. Management System Compliance

Available as a standalone service or as a bundle, we provide end-to-end Quality Management System (QMS) and Information Security Management System (ISMS) compliance. This ensures continuous improvement and permanent audit-readiness.

Standard Mapping & Alignment

Cross-referencing internal company processes against QMS/ISMS clauses.

Documented Information Control

Maintaining and updating policies, manuals, SOPs, and operational records.

Continuous Process Improvement

Designing iterative workflows that evolve with business maturity.

Internal Auditing Program

Scheduling regular audits to objectively evaluate conformance to standard requirements.

Corrective Action (CAPA)

Systematic tracking and resolution of non-conformities to prevent recurrence.

Management Review

Periodic evaluations by executive leadership to assess system suitability.

3. Second Party Auditing Services

Supplier Assessment Framework

Rigorous evaluation of third-party vendors, partners, and external suppliers to verify security posture, operational maturity, and adherence to quality agreements on behalf of your enterprise.

4. Data Center Certification Compliance

Standards Covered: Specialized framework covering ISO 9K, ISO 14K, ISO 45K, ISO 27K, ISO 27701, and ISO 22301 tailored specifically for data center environments.

Core Services

  • Evaluating existing facility workflows and environmental controls.
  • Drafting data center policies, SOPs, and capacity planning manuals.
  • Conducting specialized operations training and readiness workshops.
  • Conducting mock infrastructure and governance audits.
  • Managing seamless liaisons with accredited registrars.

Implementation Lifecycle

01
Initial Scoping: Defining perimeter and timelines.
02
Process Mapping: Aligning governance with clauses.
03
Rollout: Deploying facility controls and DR procedures.
04
Final Audit: Managing auditor reviews through accreditation.
